messages:
anna_support: FYI - escalation from Acme. They say console analytics filters (region/model/version) aren't applied — charts show global totals instead of EU. Screenshot attached.

julia_support: ack. Can you paste customer repro steps and any API outputs?

anna_support: Repro steps from customer:
1) Console -> Analytics -> Usage
2) Region = \"eu-west\"
3) Model = \"gpt-3b-q\"
4) Version = \"v2.1\"
5) Timeframe = Last 7 days

Expected: chart shows only eu-west, gpt-3b-q v2.1 traffic
Actual: chart shows global totals across regions and models

Also the customer hit the analytics API and got a different total:
```
curl -s \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/analytics/usage?region=eu-west&model=gpt-3b-q&version=v2.1&start=2024-05-01&end=2024-05-08\" | jq .total_tokens
# returns 1230456
```
Console UI shows ~380k tokens for same filters.

sam_product: Do we know if the UI applies filters client-side after fetching a pre-aggregated blob, or does the server pre-filter?

kevin_eng-platform: We rolled a metrics-aggregator migration last week that moved region into a tags field. Some pre-agg datasets may no longer contain region as a top-level partition. I'll look at the mapping.

devops-bot: Deploy 2024-06-02T14:12 by @kevin_eng-platform - metrics-aggregator v1.9.4 -> v1.10.0 (migration: region_field_to_tags)

maria_eng-analytics: I inspected the UI call. It hits /internal/analytics/ui/summary and often sets use_preagg=true to be fast. The pre-agg blob currently omits region dimension when use_preagg is true. If the client relies on preagg for dimensioned queries it will return global counts.

oncall_erin: If preagg is missing region, we have two options: toggle the client to bypass preagg for any queries that include region/model/version, or rehydrate the preagg index to include region. Client change is faster.

julia_support: This is billing-impacting for Acme. CS needs a hotfix and a backfill. Marking high priority.

kevin_eng-platform: Quick mitigation: change UI to set use_preagg=false when a region or version filter is present. I'll prepare a hotfix branch. Also scheduling a reindex job to repopulate preagg by region. Reindex dry-run:
```
./infra/tools/reindex --table=metrics_preagg --repartition=region --start=2024-04-25 --end=2024-05-08 --dry-run
```

sam_product: Agree on client fix for immediate relief. Need ETA so CS can inform Acme.

kevin_eng-platform: Hotfix ETA: 2 hours to push and roll. Reindex estimate: ~3 hours IO for 14 days, plus 1 hour verification.

maria_eng-analytics: After client change, verify the UI endpoint returns per-region totals that match raw analytics API. Backfill required for historical charts and billing reconciliation.

julia_support: Can we run a billing_reconcile once preagg is rehydrated? Acme wants their invoices corrected.

maria_eng-analytics: Yes. Billing reconcile command:
```
python tools/billing_reconcile.py --org acme --start 2024-04-25 --end 2024-05-08
```

kevin_eng-platform: Hotfix rolled to staging. Requesting prod rollout.

devops-bot: Release candidate deployed to prod: UI-service v2.3.7 (hotfix: disable_preagg_for_dimensioned_queries) - gradual roll: 5% -> 50% -> 100%

kevin_eng-platform: Rolled to 100%. Maria, can you run a quick check for Acme org using the UI endpoint with region filter?

maria_eng-analytics: Verified: with use_preagg=false the endpoint now returns totals that match the raw analytics API for eu-west + gpt-3b-q v2.1. New realtime charts should reflect correct values. Historical charts still stale until reindex completes.

kevin_eng-platform: Starting reindex job for 2024-04-25 -> 2024-05-08 now. Will monitor progress and post updates here.

anna_support: Sending customer a workaround note and timeline: client change applied, backfill & reconcile scheduled, estimated completion ~6 hours. They asked for daily updates.

oncall_erin: I'll watch logs for reindex IO spikes and alert if cluster pressure exceeds thresholds.

kevin_eng-platform: Reindex finished for 2024-04-25 -> 2024-05-08. Ran billing_reconcile for org=acme. Results: tokens increased from ~380k -> 1,230,456 matching customer's api. Reconciliation report sent to CS.

julia_support: Customer confirmed numbers match. CS will verify invoices. Marking escalation as resolved pending final confirmation tomorrow.

anna_support: Thanks everyone. Reopen if any drift appears. :thumbsup:
